## Hostinger connection check · no email access
Choose **Hostinger Mail - hello@cinematicflight.com** in the account-check node, then execute manually.

Only GET /api/v1/me is called. It returns account/mailbox metadata, not messages. No email reading, sending, flags, deletion, webhooks or NVIDIA calls. This verifies current visible mailboxes; it cannot prove the token excludes future mailboxes.

nodes.name: Hostinger - account metadata only
nodes.notes: Select the HOSTINGER credential, not NVIDIA. GET only; no messages fetched.
